mapper.select: SELECT * FROM employee WHERE employee_name = #{employeeName} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee (employee_account, employee_name, avatar, employee_gender, employee_age, specialty, certificate, intro, entry_time, staff, employee_message, employee_password) VALUES (#{employeeAccount}, #{employeeName}, #{avatar}, #{employeeGender}, #{employeeAge}, #{specialty}, #{certificate}, #{intro}, #{entryTime}, #{staff}, #{employeeMessage}, #{employeePassword})
